disorder-name.detail: Temporal lobe epilepsy clinical cohort (left/right onset) undergoing ATLR.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We studied 101 individuals with TLE (55 left, 46 right onset) who underwent ATLR."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Participants scanned at NHNN or Chalfont Centre for Epilepsy (two sites).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We included individuals with TLE in our study that received a preoperative and postoperative T1-weighted MRI scan between 2010 and 2018 at NHNN or Chalfont Centre for Epilepsy."

age.detail: Age range reported in text; mean/SD not reported.
age.supporting_text: "subjects in our study were in an age range of 19 e 60 years"

sex.detail: Counts summed across left/right TLE from Table 1 (M/F: 24/31 and 16/30). Percentages calculated from total N=101.
